provider: NAISS Arrhenius Disk / SENS Storage (Sweden) — 25 PB and 10 PB project storage, applied in GiB

free_tier.stated: Project storage is applied for in GiB through SUPR, with generous upper limits: Arrhenius Disk shows 'Upper Limit 50,000', 'Default Storage 250', 'Available 4,000,000' (GiB. So 50,000 GiB ≈ 48.8 TiB ceiling, 250 GiB default); Klemming 'Upper Limit 100,000' with 'Available 5,850,000' GiB. Arrhenius SENS Storage is a 10 PB system for sensitive data, 'only available as when applying for a related compute resource'.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: Free national e-infrastructure; no egress meter documented.

tooling: Lustre/POSIX on Arrhenius Disk (rsync/scp/sftp from a login node), no published S3 endpoint for the Disk resource. SUPR is the application portal.
chaining: Small allocations are reviewed WEEKLY. 'Proposals are reviewed weekly throughout the year'. So a Swedish-affiliated PI can iterate to the ceiling in weeks rather than waiting for an annual round. Medium is the tier that carries the 50 TB-class ceilings.
limits_note: Per-object-cap: not applicable (POSIX/Lustre). Retention: 'There is no backup of Arrhenius Disk' and storage is tied to the project; NAISS Large requires prior PI status on a Medium project. request-rate: not published. Gate: heavy. 'you must be a scientist in Swedish academia, at least at the level of assistant professor' for Medium, PhD student + 20% appointment for Small, and Large requires 'an appointment of at least 60 percent at a Swedish university'.
reliability_note: No backup on Arrhenius Disk or SENS Storage. Several listed resources (Alvis, Mimer) are mid-decommission with allocations being migrated. Check resource status before requesting.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.

extras.agent_focus: National and regional research-data infrastructure that hands out free (or grant-funded) bulk object storage to researchers: EUDAT/B2SHARE, EOSC EU Node, SURF, GÉANT ecosystem, NIRD/Sigma2, CSC Allas + LUMI-O, NAISS, DeiC, EuroHPC, DARIAH/CLARIN/ELIXIR nodes, NCI, ARDC Nectar, Digital Alliance of Canada, ACCESS/OSN, TACC, NCAR, NRP. Central question: which of these are SELF-SERVICE (anyone can get a login and a bucket) versus INSTITUTION-GATED (you need a university appointment, a national research affiliation, or a reviewed proposal). The per-project quotas here are the largest numbers in the whole survey — 10-150 TB — so the gate, not the quota, is the finding.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
